notes_for_editor: No build date, construction, staffing or fate found. Two web searches returned nothing on this tower. The only status record is the Tennessee Landforms row; the Forest Lookouts Antioch entry is a heading with no text. The record's elevation of 131.1 m matches the 430 ft listing. Leads to try: Tennessee Division of Forestry, Tipton County library or historical society, Covington newspapers.
